label: Tuindorp Oostzaan (1921-23) garden-village cottage: brick ground storey with eaves at ~2.75 m under a white timber cornice, steep pantile roof with a flat-roofed white dormer over the party wall between two window sides, paired doors (Kometensingel, Uranusstraat, Neptunusstraat, Rigelstraat, Aldebaranstraat, Betelgeuzestraat, Grote and Kleine Beerstraat, Poolsterstraat)

dormers.note: half of a six-light dormer straddling the party wall between the window sides of two houses (2147542, 2085318, 2094951); the neighbour's mirrored half completes it

green-door.evidence: survey terraces of Rigelstraat, Betelgeuzestraat, Aldebaranstraat, Siriusstraat, Argostraat, Beerstraten, Orionplantsoen, Sterrenplein (photos)

evidence.note: 2024-10, facade in shade (sun behind the row): brick ground storey to eaves ~2.75 m under a white timber cornice, big orange pantile roof; paired red doors with white frames, a 3-light living-room window beside each, a flat-roofed white dormer straddling the party wall between the window sides of two houses (three lights per house), grey zinc apron under it
2024-10 sunlit: same, red doors; dormer of six lights over the wall between two window sides; vents (four brick slits) over the door pair
2022-12 low sun: green doors, brown-orange tiles, same dormer and cornice; brick read here (sunlit)
2024-10: green doors, mossy dark pantiles, two half dormers meeting over the party wall
2024-10: same design, dormers over every second party wall

evidence.note: garden side not photographed: garden door and kitchen window inferred

notes: Eaves pinned at 2.75 m from the photos (door head + cornice): 3DBAG's b3_h_dak_min reads 2.6-2.9 m on the 8.9 m deep houses but 5.1-5.3 m on the 6.5 m deep ones (a dormer cheek or the upper roof plane), so the photo value is used for every house; the ridge stays per house from 3DBAG (7.0-7.9 m).
Houses whose 3DBAG ridge exceeds 8.1 m were raised to two storeys (Orionstraat, Maanstraat, Meteorenweg) and are held.

Dormer as one half per house on the window side (mirrored pairs); end houses whose window side is a gable end show a half dormer with a cheek, real end houses often have a small separate dormer: not modelled.
Hipped row ends follow 3DBAG per house (no dormer drawn on a hip).
Mirror parity (doors side by side) from the row alternation: inferred.
Brick from the sunlit Orionplantsoen crop (2094951) cooled for the low sun; the Uranusstraat crops are in shade and read blue-grey.
